title: Centred feature list cascade
summary: Eleven short feature lines cascade in top to bottom on black, one every 1.5 frames, each fading up and rising a quarter line, then the full list holds still for three seconds so every item can be read.
use_when: The feature rundown section of a launch film, after the product reveal
A spec or capability list of 6-12 short items that should land as one block
Silent autoplay where a dense list has to read without VO
A calm, premium keynote voice with no UI to show

look.type_style: semibold grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, cap size ~4.3 % H, line pitch 6.7 % H, centred column, block centred vertically

sfx.event: last line settles and the list is complete (f30)

structure.shot: black frame; an 11-line centred list of short feature names (1-4 words each) assembles top to bottom, then holds
structure.camera: static (motion diff 0.00 from 1.00 s on, no scale or position change between cells)
structure.motion: f0-f9 empty black; line 1 appears f10; lines cascade, stagger 1.5 fr, line 11 starts f25; each line opacity 0 -> 1 and rise ~0.25 line pitch (1.7 % H) -> 0 on easings.outExpo 6 fr; all settled f30; hold 90 fr to f120

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg, bg
params.content.items: 6-12 feature names, 1-4 words each, one line each at 16:9
params.timing.lead: empty frames before the first line (default 10)
params.timing.stagger: frames between line starts (default 1.5, fractional allowed)
params.timing.enter: frames of each line's fade + rise (default 6)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; line size scales to keep the column inside 80 % H
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from a 30 fps strip (0.20-1.17 s, +-1 fr) and the 4 fps sheet: lead 10 empty frames, 11 lines in 15 fr (stagger 1.5 fr), per-line fade + rise ~6 fr with no overshoot, settled at f30, then a fully static 3 s hold. No cuts, no audio in the reference; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed term (recipe.md): line-cascade, a centred text list whose lines fade-rise in sequence with a sub-2-frame stagger. The vocabulary list-assemble is the closest id; the studio ListAssemble component renders task rows and does not match this look, so a LineCascade component is missing.
